name: Greenhouse
description: Plant nursery & garden centre template where SVG vines grow up the page edges as you scroll, with plant shop, care-guide tabs and workshops.
features: Six hand-drawn SVG potted plants with care chips, filters and a live basket counter
Accessible tabbed care guides with keyboard arrow navigation
Weekend workshop listings and a seasonal to-do list
Visit panel with hours plus a contact form with topic selector
signature: Scroll-linked SVG vines grow along both page edges and sprout leaves, while hero leaves drift with subtle parallax
